item.title: I Asked AI to Tear Apart My Book. It Found Something I Missed.
item.description:
Seth Godin recently wrote about an interesting use of AI: find a safe critic.

Take something you’ve created—a book, an essay, a business plan, a resume—and ask an AI to attack it from a particular point of view. Ask for the one-star Amazon review. The disappointed CEO. The skeptical venture capitalist. The recruiter who doesn’t know what to do with you.
